item.title: Tip time for Pacers at Hawks moved up due to weather
item.description: ATLANTA, Ga. (WISH) — The Indiana Pacers game in Atlanta on Monday has been moved up due to inclement weather. item.title: Private jet with 8 people aboard crashes on takeoff in Maine
item.description: A private jet with eight people aboard crashed on takeoff from Bangor International Airport in Maine on Sunday evening, and the fate of the eight people on the plane was not immediately known.

item.title: Wienermobiles rev up for 2nd year of racing at Indianapolis 500 Carb Day
item.description: Oscar Mayer will bring the Wienie 500 back to Indianapolis Motor Speedway on Carb Day, May 22, featuring six Wienermobiles racing on the track for a second year.

item.title: Trump says he has approved an emergency declaration for Indiana
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — President Donald Trump has approved an emergency declaration for Indiana, among other states. An emergency declaration is an official action by a government leader that formally recognizes a crisis, such as a natural disaster and/or public health threat, and authorizes the immediate use of specialized powers and resources. item.description: CLOVERDALE, Ind. (WISH) — A male was flown to an Indianapolis hospital after he was shot in Cloverdale, Indiana, Sunday, according to the Putnam County Sheriff’s Department. item.title: Snowplow driver saves stranded motorist in Indianapolis
item.description: A snowplow driver helped a man whose car was stuck in the snow on a road that had not yet been plowed, and the man paid the driver to clear the rest of the road in his neighborhood.

item.title: Sheriff sees a few disturbance calls as snowstorm confines people at home
item.description: Gibson County Sheriff Bruce Vanoven reported a few disturbances due to people being confined inside during the snowstorm. He encouraged people to separate and cool off when tempers flare.

item.title: Winter storm winds down; frigid air, treacherous travel remain | Jan. 25, 2026
item.description: As a snowstorm with significant accumulations moves out of central Indiana, prepare for extreme cold, with temperatures dropping below zero and wind chills as low as -20 to -25 degrees for a few days.

item.title: 50 of Indiana’s 92 counties under travel warnings
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — Mayor Joe Hogsett on Sunday upgraded the travel status of Marion County to travel warning. Shortly before 10 p.m., 50 of Indiana’s 92 counties were under travel warnings, according to the Indiana Department of Homeland Security. item.title: Columbus tops central Indiana snowfall tallies in weekend storm
item.description: A winter storm hit central Indiana on Saturday and Sunday, resulting in significant snowfall, with Columbus receiving 14.8 inches and Indianapolis totaling 11.1 inches. It was the biggest snow in Indianapolis since 2014.
